description: Token health, scopes, and allowed features.
name: health

description: Fleet heartbeat from the database. Does not SSH.
name: summary

description: Counts and states for hosts, alerts, failed jobs, backups, Drive replication, and pending updates. since is optional ISO-8601. Does not replace summary. Does not SSH.
name: fleet_summary

description: List servers. limit default 100, max 100. Each server includes effective_backup_schedule, next_backup_run, and backup_scheduled.
name: list_servers

description: One server, including feature flags. Includes effective_backup_schedule, next_backup_run, and backup_scheduled. backup_scheduled is false only when backups are on, the scheduler is running, and no job is registered. Null means that state is unknown.
name: get_server

description: Stored Docker inventory. Omit server_id for the fleet. Does not SSH.

server_id.description: Host id. Omit for the whole fleet.

name: inventory

description: Stored service up/down chips. Does not poll Kuma or NPM.
name: services

description: List jobs. Pass server_id to limit the list to one host.
name: list_jobs

description: One job. detail=true includes a longer log tail.
name: get_job

description: Open notifications. Does not include dismissed or resolved rows.
name: list_alerts

description: Toggle backup, os_patch, or docker. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.
name: set_features

description: Start a Docker prune job. Needs the edit scope. prune_type is images, containers, both, or networks. both is dangling images and exited containers. Unused volumes are prune_volumes. dry_run is a best-effort preview of dangling volumes, not an exact match. confirm true deletes them. HTTP 202 means accepted. HTTP 409 means a prune is already active: poll get_job and do not start another.

prune_type.description: Default both. Volumes are not accepted.

name: prune_docker

description: Prune the Docker build cache and the buildx cache on one host. Needs the edit scope. One audit row. Not a docker_prune job and not scheduled.
name: prune_build_cache

description: Prune unused Docker volumes on one host. dry_run true is a best-effort preview of dangling volumes and sizes. It deletes nothing. That set can differ slightly from what docker volume prune -f removes on newer Docker versions, and there is a small time gap between the dry run and the delete. It is not an exact match. confirm is not required for a dry run. confirm true deletes them and writes one audit row. Needs the edit scope. Not a docker_prune job and not scheduled. Dry-run first and get a human's OK.

confirm.description: Must be true to delete. Not required when dry_run is true.

dry_run.description: Best-effort preview of dangling volumes and sizes. Not an exact match for docker volume prune -f. Deletes nothing.

name: prune_volumes

description: Start backup, retention, os_patch, container_patch, os_update_check, container_update_check, container_start, container_stop, container_restart, container_redeploy, host_reboot, docker_stack_check, docker_stack_deploy, docker_stack_stop, docker_stack_start, docker_stack_restart, template_deploy, or template_redeploy. For a docker_stack job, source_filter is the compose project path. container_start, container_stop, container_restart, and container_redeploy require service (one compose service name) and source_filter (the compose project directory). HTTP 202 means accepted. HTTP 409 means that job is already active: poll get_job and do not start another.

job_type.description: One of the jobs POST types

service.description: Compose service name. Required for container_start, container_stop, container_restart, and container_redeploy

source_filter.description: Backup source name, the compose project path for a docker_stack job, or the compose project directory for container_start, container_stop, container_restart, and container_redeploy (required for those four)

name: trigger_job

description: Start a stop-first Move of one compose project. server_id is the source. dest_server_id is the destination. project is the compose project name, not a directory. confirm must be true. The source stack is left stopped. There is no undo. HTTP 202 means accepted. HTTP 409 means a stack, Move, or backup is already running: poll get_job.

confirm.description: Must be true. The source stack is left stopped.

project.description: Compose project name. Not a filesystem path.

name: start_move

description: Read LAN Discovery. Omit integration_id to list saved ranges and the latest scan. Pass integration_id for recent scans and a short device list. That list stops at 50 and includes total. Page the rest with list_discovery_devices. Pass run_id with integration_id for one scan. No credentials and no script output.
name: read_discovery

description: Start a LAN Discovery scan of the ranges saved on that integration. confirm must be true. intensity is discovery, inventory, detailed, or deep. The agent does not choose targets. Vulnerability scripts stay off. HTTP 202 means accepted.

intensity.description: discovery, inventory, detailed, or deep. Default discovery.

name: start_discovery

description: Page LAN Discovery devices. state is new, known, linked, ignored, or stale. limit defaults to 50 and caps at 200. offset pages. No MAC, notes, or script output.

state.description: new, known, linked, ignored, or stale

name: list_discovery_devices

description: Set the operator name on one LAN Discovery device. Kind and map role stay. A new or offline device becomes known. Pass an empty display_name to clear the name.
name: rename_discovery_device

description: Set a LAN Discovery device to known, new, or ignored. A linked device cannot be marked new. Marking known leaves a linked device linked.
name: set_discovery_device_state

description: Ignore a stale LAN Discovery row that shares this device's hostname and IP. Copies display name, kind override, and notes onto this MAC. One audit row. Identity stays the MAC.
name: replace_stale_mac

description: Link a LAN Discovery device to a fleet server.
name: link_discovery_device

description: Unlink a LAN Discovery device. The device becomes known.
name: unlink_discovery_device

description: Permanently delete one LAN Discovery device. confirm must be true. A linked device is refused. There is no undo.

confirm.description: Must be true. There is no undo.

name: purge_discovery_device

description: Permanently delete offline LAN Discovery devices. confirm must be true. Linked devices stay. There is no undo. The result lists the removed ids.

confirm.description: Must be true. There is no undo.

name: purge_stale_discovery_devices

description: Scan one LAN Discovery device. confirm must be true. intensity is discovery, inventory, detailed, or deep. Default deep. The device address must sit inside the saved ranges. Vulnerability scripts stay off. HTTP 202 means accepted.

intensity.description: discovery, inventory, detailed, or deep. Default deep.

name: scan_discovery_device

description: List a fleet-jail directory. p is jail-relative.
name: list_files

description: Download one fleet-jail file. Sensitive. Secret-looking names are refused. Result is capped around 256 KiB and says when it was cut.
name: read_file

description: Upload text into the fleet jail. p is the directory. name is the file basename. Cap 256 KiB.
name: write_file

description: Create a directory in the fleet jail. p is the parent. name is the new directory.
name: mkdir

description: Rename inside the current fleet-jail directory.
name: rename_file

description: Delete one file or an empty directory in the fleet jail. Not recursive.
name: delete_file
